description: Orthographic source texts behind the perception IPA files: the passages in each language's own script, as fed to turkic-translit. These are what regeneration and the rules-vs-data byte-identity check need; until 2026-08-12 the repository held only the tool's output, so the rules could not be checked against the data at all.

files.AZERI_test_items.docx: original as received 2026-08-12 (arrived after the other five); source_az.txt is its paragraph text extracted verbatim
files.KAZAKH_test_items.docx: original as received; source_kk.txt is its paragraph text extracted verbatim
files.UYGHUR_test_items.docx: original; source_ug.txt extracted. Title lines are bilingual: an English title on the TEXT line and the Uyghur title on the following line. Regeneration must treat both as structure, not passage text.
files.UZBEK_test_items.docx: original; source_uz.txt extracted. The first title line reads TEXT1: with no space, one of the header spellings the eval's parser already covers.

notes: All six Turkic sources are present. Finnish needs no entry here; its source is data/perception/perception_fi_source.txt.
Extraction: each docx's word/document.xml paragraphs, in order, one line per paragraph, no edits. The .docx originals are kept beside the extractions so the extraction itself is checkable.

Not yet used for regeneration. The perception files in data/perception/ remain the 0.3.x-era outputs the current results were computed on; regenerating them belongs to the full pipeline re-run (rules 0.5.1, corpora rebuild, retrain), so that train and eval move together rather than creating a third mixed state.
